_comment: Per-provider weekly token budgets for usage-meters.mjs pace verdicts. Read by _SYSTEM/runtime/usage-meters.mjs (loadConfig). These are PACING TARGETS (pace-to-consume-by-period-end), NOT hard caps — the verdict is advisory UP/HOLD/DOWN only and never blocks a lane. Calibrated 2026-07-05 from observed weekly throughput (governor report: zai/other ~269M/wk, anthropic main+sonnet ~178M/wk against Max-20x 2B pools). Pools: zai (z.ai GLM/glm-max/glm-flash/zai-tmux/cline:glm), ollama (ollama-cloud: deepseek/kimi/minimax), anthropic (Sonnet/Opus/Haiku — Max subscription, flat usage not $).
